output.answer: The wiki has no notes about "station" agents (the word only appears in weather contexts); "desk" snaps to two things. Most recent, by note timestamp: (1) engineering/opencode.md (2026-10-26) — OpenCode as a headless server runtime, which is the runtime for every cheap-model *desk*, plus production lessons from agent-gateway. (2) engineering/agent-loops-vs-runtimes.md (2026-10-26) — keeps the gateways as engines and puts open-ended steerable agents (the *research desk* profile, a podcast producer) on the OpenCode server above them. (3) engineering/remote-dev-stack.md (2026-10-05) — the mini-as-dev-host stack, where `desk [session]` (= `herdr --remote mini`) runs the client locally and the panes on the mini.
